{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Cloud.SDK.RateLimit where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.IORef
import Control.Concurrent (threadDelay)
import Control.Exception (SomeException, catch, throwIO)
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime, diffUTCTime)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Rate limiter state
data RateLimitState = RateLimitState
  { rlTokens    :: !Int
  , rlLastReset :: !UTCTime
  , rlMaxTokens :: !Int
  , rlWindow    :: !Int  -- seconds
  }

-- Query builder for cloud resource lookups
data QueryContext = QueryContext
  { qcTenantId   :: Text
  , qcRegion     :: Text
  , qcResourceId :: Text
  , qcRetryCount :: Int
  , qcMaxRetries :: Int
  }

-- Sanitization layer - escapes SQL metacharacters
sanitizeIdentifier :: Text -> Text
sanitizeIdentifier input = 
  let dangerous = ["'", ";", "--", "/*", "*/", "\\"]
      cleaned = foldl (\acc c -> T.replace c "" acc) input dangerous
  in cleaned

-- Build parameterized query for normal lookups
buildResourceQuery :: QueryContext -> Text
buildResourceQuery ctx =
  let safeTenant = sanitizeIdentifier (qcTenantId ctx)
      safeRegion = sanitizeIdentifier (qcRegion ctx)
      safeResource = sanitizeIdentifier (qcResourceId ctx)
  in T.concat
    [ "SELECT resource_data FROM cloud_resources WHERE "
    , "tenant_id = '", safeTenant, "' "
    , "AND region = '", safeRegion, "' "
    , "AND resource_id = '", safeResource, "'"
    ]

-- Retry decorator that modifies query on failure
data RetryStrategy = RetryStrategy
  { rsBackoffMs   :: Int
  , rsJitter      :: Bool
  , rsFallback    :: Bool  -- use fallback query on final retry
  }

defaultRetry :: RetryStrategy
defaultRetry = RetryStrategy 100 True True

-- Fallback query builder used when primary lookup exhausts retries
-- Uses broader search to find resources across regions
buildFallbackQuery :: QueryContext -> Text
buildFallbackQuery ctx =
  let safeTenant = sanitizeIdentifier (qcTenantId ctx)
      -- On fallback, search by resource pattern across all regions
      -- Uses LIKE for fuzzy matching when exact lookup fails
      resourcePattern = qcResourceId ctx  -- raw for LIKE pattern
  in T.concat
    [ "SELECT resource_data, region FROM cloud_resources WHERE "
    , "tenant_id = '", safeTenant, "' "
    , "AND resource_id LIKE '", resourcePattern, "'"
    ]

-- Rate limit check
checkRateLimit :: IORef RateLimitState -> IO Bool
checkRateLimit ref = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  state <- readIORef ref
  let elapsed = diffUTCTime now (rlLastReset state)
  if elapsed > fromIntegral (rlWindow state)
    then do
      writeIORef ref state { rlTokens = rlMaxTokens state - 1, rlLastReset = now }
      return True
    else if rlTokens state > 0
      then do
        writeIORef ref state { rlTokens = rlTokens state - 1 }
        return True
      else return False

-- Execute query with retry logic
executeWithRetry :: IORef RateLimitState -> RetryStrategy -> QueryContext -> (Text -> IO a) -> IO a
executeWithRetry rlRef strategy ctx execFn = go 0
  where
    go attempt = do
      allowed <- checkRateLimit rlRef
      if not allowed
        then do
          threadDelay (rsBackoffMs strategy * 1000 * (attempt + 1))
          go attempt  -- don't count rate-limit waits as retries
        else do
          let query = if attempt >= qcMaxRetries ctx && rsFallback strategy
                      then buildFallbackQuery ctx
                      else buildResourceQuery ctx
          result <- (Just <$> execFn query) `catch` \(e :: SomeException) -> return Nothing
          case result of
            Just r  -> return r
            Nothing ->
              if attempt < qcMaxRetries ctx
                then do
                  threadDelay (rsBackoffMs strategy * 1000 * (2 ^ attempt))
                  go (attempt + 1)
                else do
                  -- Final attempt with fallback
                  let fallbackQ = buildFallbackQuery ctx
                  execFn fallbackQ

-- Public API: lookup cloud resource
lookupResource :: IORef RateLimitState -> Text -> Text -> Text -> (Text -> IO a) -> IO a
lookupResource rlRef tenant region resourceId execFn =
  let ctx = QueryContext
        { qcTenantId   = tenant
        , qcRegion     = region
        , qcResourceId = resourceId
        , qcRetryCount = 0
        , qcMaxRetries = 3
        }
  in executeWithRetry rlRef defaultRetry ctx execFn
